task:
Review the locale-aware PDF rendering changes that:
1. Make all 4 generated PDFs (sales invoice + Trial Balance + P&L + Balance Sheet) honour the user's selected UI language (ar/en/de/fr) via ?lang= or ctx.locale instead of hardcoded ar+en bilingual strings.
2. Fix Arabic shaping defects: strip U+200E/F, U+061C, U+202A-E, U+2066-9 bidi controls before shaping; pass lineBreak: false on every .text() drawing pre-shaped Arabic; bypass bidi-js with a literal reverse for pure-Arabic strings (preserves the inter-word space in 'النقد بالصندوق').

Focus areas:
- Locale plumbing correctness (parseLangParam fallback chain ?lang -> body.locale -> 'ar')
- Arabic shaping: pure-Arabic fast path correctness vs bidi-js path for digits/brackets
- Coverage of all 4 PDF generators
- pdfkit lineBreak:false invariant is applied consistently
